source.commitProvenance: Exact published source and build-settings match; source-equivalent commits prevent uniquely inferring the deployment checkout.

limitations: Only flags 0x00 and 0x01 with this exact runtime are admitted; flags 0x02/0x03 select ERC20 mode and are rejected.
Flag 0x00 requires the transaction origin to be in the paymaster bundler allowlist; flag 0x01 allows all bundlers.
The parser permits 64-byte signatures, but the pinned OpenZeppelin ECDSA.recover(bytes) rejects them; the admitted signature is exactly 65 bytes.
Source and historical code observations do not prove current sponsorship approval, signer membership, account installation, or funds.
